hierarchy.message: Mardling-Aarseth stability: 93x the critical a_out/a_in=51.20 at the tighter epoch; inner binary 292x inside its Hill radius about the lens; point source, geometric a_in/a_out = 2.11e-04 and wave-optics a_in/eta_0 = 6.40e-03 at conjunction (eta_0 = 8.954e+09 m), the latter 30x tighter and the one that governs. Requires 10x margin on the first two, <1e-3 and <1e-2 on the last two.

outer_orbit_is_static_over_the_observati.message: outer orbit's own GW decay time = 4.00e+07 yr, of which 1.6e-08 elapses before the inner binary merges (require <1e-4, so a_out is fixed); Kozai-Lidov t_KL = 16.1 yr is 24x the time to merger, and further quenched by inner GR precession, t_KL/t_GR = 3.4e+04 (require >100)

quasi_monochromatic_regime.message: 60.2 outer periods before merger (observing 3 of them); fractional freq drift over the observing baseline = 1.94e-02 (require merger>>observing window, drift<5%)

wave_optics_regime_nontrivial.message: w_B=0.309 (require <1, diffractive); Case A band w=61.9 to 777.6 (require >30 throughout, geometric optics)

adiabatic_approximation_where_it_is_appl.message: t_resp = 4GM_L/c^3 = 0.985 s; where |F|>1.01, min |dln y/dt|^-1 / t_resp = 5845x at 8e3 samples and 5844x at 2e4 (require >100x, and agreement to 5% between the two so the number is the system's and not the grid's)

deflection_is_weak_where_the_rays_pass.message: closest any ray comes is the Einstein ring, xi_0 = 121 r_g (require >50); second-order deflection is 2.43% there (the y->0 bound, require <5%) and 1.17% at the y actually used, y_min=1.589 -> x_+=2.072
